description: Ex USAF 54-552; data plate missing. Displayed at the RTAF Museum until replaced by L4-6/07 in 1983 and at the Anti-Aircraft Artillery Regiment since at least April 1994. Marked 552-01.
Ex Royal Thai Police, fitted with the tail boom of 1728. Rotorless at Don Mueang from 1995 and at the Anti-Aircraft Artillery Regiment since about 2017.
